transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us started on the activation plan review for the opening-night livestream. As we head into the pre-launch sign-off, I'll be going through the plan alongside the sponsorship contracts, broadcast traffic, and audience-data compliance before we lock the rundown and any public-facing materials. I know the draft currently includes a Brightline logo on the stage backdrop, a ten-minute commercial break, audience email collection for sponsor follow-up, and a host thank-you during the award presentation. Since Brightline Mobile is the presenting sponsor for the livestream, I want to make sure we're all aligned. What should I know from your end before I make my approval decision?
